a97692d98da7.title: Possible Logic Error in Quiet Hours
a97692d98da7.reason: hour*60+minute is at most 1439; with the offset rem_euclid(1440) gives the local minute of the day, and from>to spans are handled by local >= from || local < to. Tested at 23:30, 06:59, 07:00, with +120 and a daytime span.

bae46718b0cc.title: Potential Security Issue in Trace Retention
bae46718b0cc.reason: '{}' and '""' are both valid JSON for the empty request object and response string; shown() reads either. Bodies are masked when shown and capped when stored.

bcb6fa6579ac.title: Potential Data Loss in Daily Summary Query
bcb6fa6579ac.reason: last_daily is only ever written with util::now() (RFC 3339 text), so its first 10 characters are the date; this query is unchanged except for mail_on.

c8e0207ee17c.title: Hard-coded Push Service Hosts
c8e0207ee17c.reason: The allowlist is the point: subscriptions may only send to the browsers' push services (no SSRF to internal hosts). The suffix check needs a label before the suffix; the tests try look-alike hosts.

d21ffb79f257.title: Hard-coded Secrets Risk
d21ffb79f257.reason: KOMPANION_SMTP_PASSWORD_FILE is set by whoever runs the server (compose/.env), not by a user; someone who can set the server's environment already controls it. The value is only used as the SMTP password and never shown.

dc9ddb6b425a.title: Possible Issue
dc9ddb6b425a.reason: See a97692d98da7: the minute-of-day arithmetic with rem_euclid is exact for any offset; the test with tz_offset 120 checks 05:30 and 04:30 UTC around a 07:00 end.

f19fd0971be4.title: Missing Error Handling for Provider Lookup
f19fd0971be4.reason: local only picks the result budget; a missing provider is refused right after in run_in with "The provider ... is not configured.", so nothing runs on a guessed provider.

f2280a9df4d0.title: Potential Data Loss on Migration
f2280a9df4d0.reason: The new columns are NOT NULL with defaults (1 for on_approval, mail_on, push_on), so existing rows read true, which is what the app shows for a missing value too.
